This armour is a perfectly crafted balance of portability and protection for a busy plane-walker, always on the go and ever-harried by all sorts of interesting foes.

This particular set has suffered some damage when its previous owner wasn't quite fleet of foot enough to dodge some devastating blow - better luck to you!
Slipping out from the clutches of a nearby threat, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.
When an enemy hits the wearer with a melee attack, gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_WW_CE_MistyStep">Plane-Walker's Evasion</LSTag> for the next turn.

Add your full Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>. Additionally, this armour does not impose <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Stealth <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.
This armour is a perfectly crafted balance of portability and protection for a busy plane-walker, always on the go and ever-harried by all sorts of interesting foes.
Plane-walkers are on their feet all day every day, and therefore demand comfortable boots. Let's be clear - these are VERY comfortable boots.
A practiced plane-walker knows how to bear the weight of their pack just so, increasing their <LSTag Tooltip="CarryWeight">carrying capacity</LSTag> by half.
Your <LSTag Tooltip="CarryWeight">carrying capacity</LSTag> is increased by half.
